topics.topic: Effect of trial-corpus growth on an existing contract-version activation
questions: After the corpus grows, is the previously active implementation still runnable, automatically re-admitted, or no longer a usable current activation until a new admission succeeds?
Does adding or capturing a trial case invalidate, suspend, or leave usable the contract version's existing activation?

quotes:
Read by activation, which requires an `admitted`
verdict over the current corpus.
judgement.why: The change did not touch this activation requirement or make the effect of corpus growth newly relevant.

topics.topic: How TrialExecution records distinguish manual from admission executions and identify the requesting agent
questions: What fact distinguishes an agent-requested trial execution from a kernel-run admission execution, and which agent requested an explicit trial?
How does a TrialExecution record distinguish an agent-requested trial from an execution created automatically during admission, and which agent requested a manual trial?

quotes:
The owner's actions,
each agent's and the kernel's own are distinguishable in every record.
judgement.why: The change only refined TrialExecution outputs and did not touch or newly affect actor attribution.

topics.topic: Whether NodeExecution has attempt-coordinate identity or content-derived value identity
questions: Is a NodeExecution an entity identified by its attempt coordinates, or a content-derived value subject to value equality and deduplication?
Is NodeExecution an entity identified by its run/node/map/attempt coordinates, or a content-derived value?

quotes:
Substitution: an attempt's record is issued once. Continuity: none; a further
attempt is a further record.
judgement.why: The change did not touch NodeExecution identity or make its classification newly relevant.

topics.topic: Whether ProofResult identity is fixed by flow version or contextual to mutable binding status
questions: What is the identity and meaning of a ProofResult when mutable binding status can make the same flow version produce different results at different times?
Is a ProofResult determined only by `flow_version_id`, or is it a contextual observation that may change as referenced binding statuses change?

quotes: Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result. Continuity: none.
judgement.why: The change did not touch ProofResult identity or the binding-status context that prompted the topic.

topics.topic: Authorization required to compose flow versions and propose operation bindings
questions: Does the may-author right also govern composing flow versions and proposing operation bindings, or are those actions available to every authenticated agent?

topics.topic: Behavior of repeated grant requests when the flow version is inactive
questions: If a grant is already active for a node whose flow version is no longer active, does another grant request return that existing grant or refuse because the version is not currently active?

topics.topic: Bytes and canonicalization rules used for value and file digests
questions: What bytes are hashed for StoredValue.value_digest, SpooledFile.content_digest and trial file digests, and which digests—if any—are governed by the global JCS rule?

topics.topic: MCP operation for releasing a failed run
questions: Is releasing a failed run an MCP product action, and if so which named surface operation performs it?

topics.topic: Manifest operations requiring idempotency-key declarations and behavior when absent
questions: Which manifest operations require a usable idempotency-key declaration, and is a binding proposal or invocation refused when that declaration is absent or empty?

topics.topic: Where the requester of a kernel-performed read-only flow activation is recorded
questions: Where is the owner or agent who requested a kernel-performed read-only activation recorded?

topics.topic: Whether a run can be cancelled while an effect outcome is unknown
questions: May the owner cancel a run while an EffectAttempt is `unknown`, thereby leaving that outcome permanently unresolved?

topics.topic: Whether installation identity changes when its configuration changes
questions: Does a configuration change create a different Installation value, or does one stable installation continue while its live configuration changes?

topics.topic: Whether invalid flow graphs create a failed FlowVersion or are rejected before creation
questions: Does composing a cyclic or otherwise structurally invalid candidate create and retain a FlowVersion with a failed ProofResult, or is it refused before any FlowVersion exists?

topics.topic: Whether invalid flow inputs create a failed Run or are rejected before run creation
questions: Are flow inputs validated before run_id is minted, with invalid inputs refusing the action and creating no Run, or does the kernel create a Run that ends failed?

topics.topic: Whether repeated admission reuses an AdmissionVerdict or creates a new one
questions: When admission is repeated for the same implementation and unchanged corpus, is the existing AdmissionVerdict reused, or is a new verdict record created for the new TrialExecututions?

topics.topic: Which TrialExecution records are created by one try-implementation action
questions: Which TrialExecution records does one `try an implementation` action create?

topics.topic: Which activation actions agents may invoke through MCP
questions: Which activation requests may agents invoke through MCP: read-only flow activation, function rollback, both, or neither?
